clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, Doan Karhan studies the Burning Legion’s demonic artifacts. A human scholar and practitioner of the dark arts, he lives alone to pursue his research, especially into the enigmatic Orb of Soran'ruk.

Doan Karhan keeps a solitary camp in the southern Barrens, far from the Alliance’s civilized bastions. He withdrew into the wilderness to study dangerous demonic relics without disturbance. He knows much about powerful fel vessels, possesses the Orb of Zargain, and is absorbed by the legendary Orb of Soran'ruk. Warlocks seeking knowledge of artifact crafting and dark rituals often come to him.
